description: This file defines core classes and functions for the Facebook PHP SDK, including a custom Exception class (FacebookApiException) and an abstract base class (BaseFacebook) that provides methods for interacting with Facebook's APIs, handling authentication, HTTP requests, and signed requests.

classes.name: FacebookApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing errors returned from the Facebook API, storing the result object and providing methods to retrieve error details and string representation.

classes.name: BaseFacebook
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for Facebook API interaction, including authentication management, HTTP request handling, signed request parsing, and URL generation. It is designed to be subclassed with specific persistent storage implementations.

methods.name: FacebookApiException.__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the result object, determines the error message and code based on the result.

methods.name: FacebookApiException.getResult
methods.description: Returns the result object from the API call that caused the exception.

methods.name: FacebookApiException.getType
methods.description: Returns the error type based on the result object.

methods.name: FacebookApiException.__toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the exception for debugging purposes.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.__construct
methods.description: Initializes the Facebook object with provided configuration, setting application ID, secret, and other options.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getAppId
methods.description: Returns the stored Facebook app ID.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getAppSecret
methods.description: Returns the stored Facebook app secret.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the access token to be used for API calls.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the access token, either cached or determined via various means (signed request, persistent storage).

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getSignedRequest
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the signed request token from request or cookies.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getUser
methods.description: Returns the user ID of the currently authenticated user or 0 if not authenticated.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.destroySession
methods.description: Clears the current session data, cookies, and cached tokens.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current URL with Facebook-specific query parameters stripped.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getSignedRequestCookieName
methods.description: Constructs the cookie name used for the signed request.

methods.name: BaseFacebook.getMetadataCookie
methods.description: Parses cookie data related to Facebook metadata.
